mechanism: Amphetamine increases sympathomimetic activity and tachycardia risk while everolimus may cause hypertension and cardiac effects, with additive cardiovascular stress; amphetamine may also inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of everolimus.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and cardiac function closely; consider alternative ADHD medications with lower sympathomimetic activity; adjust everolimus levels if amphetamine is necessary.
